name: 3W Clinic Placenta Eye Cream 40ml | Korea
description: The Snail Mucus Gold Eye Cream is designed to target and improve wrinkles and skin brightness around the delicate eye area. Infused with snail mucus filtrate, 24K gold, and shea butter, this cream boosts skin elasticity, provides intense moisture, and helps reduce fine lines. With its functional formula tested for whitening and wrinkle improvement, it also avoids harmful ingredients, making it safe for sensitive skin.
